s: Seder tepillat neila ubo y"[b] seipim: bimqomot sheomerim "ashre uba letziyyon" qodem tepillat mincha — tzerikim lachazor velomar "ashre" qodem tepillat neila, kede lehapsiq ben mincha linila, mittaam shennitbaer besiman q"ch veq"h:

Hatchalat zeman tepillat neila hu keshehachamma berosh hailanot, dehaynu qarob lehatchalat hashsheqia, venimshak zemannah ad samuk letzet hakkokabim. Lepikak tzarik hashsheliach tzibbur leqatztzer bislichot upiyyutim shebbeemtza hattepilla, vegam en lo limshok bitpillat neila kol teba veteba kederek shemmoshek bishar tepillot, kede sheyyigmor qodem tzet hakkokabim, lepi shettepilla zo hi betaanit tzibbur keneged neilat shaare hekal shebbammiqdash shehaya bayyom achar hadlaqat nerot shel ben haarbayim, keebed harotzeh latzet min hammelek umiqqodem sheyyetze hu mebaqqesh peras umenat hammelek veyotze venoel hashshaar acharayv:

Abal yesh omerim sheyyekolin lehaarik ulehamshik bitpillat neila gam ballayla, veap al pi shehu achar neilat shaare hekal, lepi shello tiqqenu kelal lehitpallel tepilla zo beet neilat shaare hekal, umah shenniqra tepillat neila, haynu lepi shemmitpalelin otah besop hayyom vehi gemar tepillot shel hayyom, umitpalelin otah samuk linilat shaare shamayim shennoalin otam bigmar hattepillot:

Veap al pi shehaiqqar kassebara harishona, mikkol maqom akshav shennohagin kassebara haacharona — en limchot beyadam, umikkol maqom tzerikin lehatchil beod hayyom gadol, vegam yizzaharu lomar charuz "hayyom yipneh ku'" qodem haareb shemesh, deim lo ken hu dober sheqarim lipne Hashem:

Veim hu shabbat — mazkir shel shabbat bitpilla zo kederek shemmazkir bishar tepillot hayyom, shehare adayin yom shabbat hu, vaapillu otam hammamshikim tepilla zo ballayla, mikkol maqom kevan shehitchilu mibbeod yom — tzarik lehazkir shel shabbat (kemo shennitbaer besiman qp"ch). Abal bavvidduy shelleachar hattepilla — en mazkirin bo shel shabbat, kevan shekkebar siyyem birkat shabbat (dehaynu "atta bechartanu" shechotemin "meqaddesh hashshabbat") velo matzinu hazkara achar siyyum habberaka, kemo shennitbaer besiman tk"h, ayyen sham. Bammeh debarim amurim? Beyachid, abal hashsheliach tzibbur kevan sheomer havvidduy betok hattepilla — tzarik lehazkir shel shabbat be"atta hibdalta enosh ku'" kederek shemmazkir bo shel yom hakkippurim, shehare birkat "atta bechartanu" hi meyuchedet leshabbat uleyom hakkippurim, shehare mazkir bah shel shabbat battechilla "vattitten lanu et yom hashshabbat hazzeh veku'" ubassop chotem "meqaddesh hashshabbat ku'". Umikkol maqom, im lo hizkir shel shabbat betok havvidduy — en machazirin oto, kevan shehizkiro betok hattepilla. Abal im lo hizkir shel shabbat kelal apillu betok hattepilla — machazirin oto, ben yachid ben sheliach tzibbur:
Bemaqom sheomerim "keter" bemusap — omerim gam ken binila, ubimqomot sheomerim "naaritzeka" bemusap — omerim gam ken binila:

Noseim kappayim binila. Ulepi shennesiat kappayim huqqesha laaboda kemo shennitbaer besiman qk"ch vaaboda enah ella bayyom, lepikak tzarik hashsheliach tzibbur lemaher bitpillat neila uledalleg hasselichot im en shehut bayyom beinyan shettehe nesiat kappayim bayyom qodem tzet hakkokabim. Abal bimdinot ellu en nohagin ken, ella en hakkohanim olin laddukan kelal binila, lepi shemmaarikin bislichot upizmonim ad hallayla veen nesiat kappayim ballayla. Abal mikkol maqom omer hashsheliach tzibbur "eloqenu veloqe abotenu barekenu ku'" ap al pi shehu layla, shebbazeh en qepeda kol kak, kevan shettepilla zo reuya linsiat kappayim, shehare hatchalat zemannah hi mibbeod yom:

Veachar hattepilla omerim "abinu malkenu" apillu keshechal beshabbat, vaapillu adayin hu yom, veap al pi shebbekol hayyom en omerim "abinu malkenu" keshehu shabbat, mikkol maqom akshav yesh leomro, lepi sheakshav hu gemar hachatima veanu tzerikin lebaqqashat rachamim, veim lo akshav — ematay:

Besop hasselichot omerim "shema yisrael" paam achat, veshalosh peamim "baruk shem kebod malkuto leolam vaed", veachar kak omerim sheba peamim "Hashem hu haelohim" lelavvot hashshekina shettaaleh vetistalleq akshav lemala mishshiba reqiim, shebbeet hattepilla hayeta hashshekina sheruya benenu veakshav taaleh limqomah:

Veomerim qaddish shalem, veachar kak toqein teqia achat, veyesh nohagin litqoa tshr"t. Veap al pi sheadayin lo hibdilu battepilla — ap al pi ken en kan issur kelal, kevan shehatteqia enah melaka kelal veen bah apillu mishshum shebut gamur kemo shennitbaer besiman taqap"[ch], velo aseru beshabbat veyom tob ella mishshum ubdin dechol kemo shennitbaer sham, lepikak yesh lehattir teqia zo apillu ben hashshemashot im kebar gameru tepillat neila (veayyen besiman shm"b):

Yad [yab] vetaam teqia zo hi siman lesilluq shekina lemala, kemo shehaya bemattan tora shekkesheolta hashshekina neemar "bimshok hayyobel veku'", veneemar "ala elohim bitrua ku'". Veod yesh taam bitqia zo, leharot shehu yom tob uleharbot bisuda, mippene sheen yom tob zeh mepursam — asu bo taqqana leparsemo, laken yipqedu ish et reehu betzeto mibbet hakkeneset kederek sheomerim beshabbat veyom tob:
